questions.sensed_quantity: front displacement charge at a bipolar summing input
questions.loading: finite differential-pair loop; base shot noise remains
questions.dc_bias: Two parallel ordinary 1Mohm feedback resistors (500kohm nominal) increase DC base-current authority; fixed discrete pair/tail, no trimming
questions.gain_or_impedance_transformation: discrete differential error amplifier, 100 nF feedback and emitter followers
questions.balanced_output: Real output devices and two 47 ohm/47 uF legs; harvest/cable/load coupling measured, symmetry not presumed
questions.expected_noise: base-current shot noise, feedback resistor and collector/output noise; missing KF explicitly unknown
questions.expected_distortion: differential pair curvature, finite loop gain, unequal follower bias
questions.likely_fatal_flaw: low reset resistance requires very large Cfb and loses sensitivity/SNR
questions.quickest_falsification: base current/feedback authority, pressure-referred shot noise and finite-loop response
questions.hypothesis: An entirely BJT audio/power path can perform charge feedback without a FET, but base-current noise and DC authority may dominate the LF budget.

topology.hypothesis: An entirely BJT audio/power path can perform charge feedback without a FET, but base-current noise and DC authority may dominate the LF budget.
topology.structural_changes: Specify obtainable AC-series 10k parts and test a 500kohm DC feedback branch realized as two parallel 1Mohm resistors. Lower reset resistance trades base-current authority against charge gain/noise; no selection or excess-noise equivalence. Preserve BJT-only mechanism and rerun complete supported suite.

metrics.safe_capsule_bias: unknown; simulated voltage is not approved for hardware

operating_point.coverage: DC feasibility screen; device safe operating area remains a separate evidence gate

frequency_response.coverage: 1 Hz to 10 MHz, nominal environment; electrical model only

noise.coverage: Resistive fixture noise; conditional capsule sensitivity. Semiconductor and capsule mechanical noise unresolved.

metrics.common_mode_drive: Preamp input midpoint relative to supply earth; fixture susceptibility, not microphone intrinsic CMRR

phantom_supply.coverage: 8 DC/AC supply/feed extremes. Noise/distortion/abuse at corners pending.

temperature.coverage: 3 electrical temperatures; no validated mechanical or leakage temperature law

metrics.reason: Assumed scenario distributions and screening coverage; real production statistics unknown.
metrics.distributions: Independent uniform scenario ranges; leakage log-uniform; not manufacturer distributions

metrics.definition: 3-port Y subtraction of the capsule; input C/G with other electrodes AC-clamped. Dynamic floating/bootstrap behavior is retained in raw Y matrix.

loading.coverage: Electrical loading and 16 assumed capsule corners; not an acoustic polar or mechanical model

startup.coverage: Symmetric cold turn-on PWL. Hot-plug, asymmetric pin connection, disconnect, RF/ESD pending.
